subject.title: [Bug]: Mac app node rejects allowlisted host=node commands

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102536 be treated as the canonical fix for this protected macOS node allowlist bug once its gates pass?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and paired with an open closing PR, but the issue has a protected `maintainer` label and the fix touches a security-sensitive remote-exec approval boundary.

options.title: Review and land linked PR
options.body: Use the linked PR as the canonical fix if review confirms the approval binding remains canonical and CI/Testbox gates pass.

options.title: Request a different fix shape
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a different implementation if maintainers want Mac nodes to implement `system.run.prepare` instead of a gateway legacy transport payload.

options.title: Close after main contains fix
options.body: Leave the issue open until the accepted fix merges, then close it as implemented with the merge commit and release/main provenance.

recommendation.title: Review and land linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR as the canonical fix if review confirms the approval binding remains canonical and CI/Testbox gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is both the linked fix author and a recurring owner of the node exec approval-plan path in repository history.
